label: Straight Fly
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Zoomed crop of the fly area shows the topstitch as one perfectly straight vertical run from the waistband down to a bar tack — no curved/J-shaped finish at the base, which is exactly what distinguishes a straight topstitched (military) fly from the conventional curved fly stitch. Real cloth with visible weave and specular sheen, mannequin neck visible top-right: a photograph, not line art.
